items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: Even with the little band I had when I was with him, he had -- he used Billy Kyle as a musical director. ... Billy Kyle would instruct them on just what key Louis did this or that in

ctx.x: Oh, you went directly from Tommy Miles into Earl's band?

Yeah, because Jimmy Mundy went first, and he told Earl about us. He said I can get some guys can really help your band. So, I was one of the guys that came over. And this is before Billy -- I knew Eckstine before he came with Tommy too. He came a little later. He was with Tommy when Tyree was with him. They came in after we left out. But Eckstine used to sing with us off and on, but he never did sing regularly until after we left, see.
I see. And then did he -- when did he come into Earl's band? He came in --
